allocation_semantics: Before canonicalization bound the complete typed Document nodes, conservative JSON bytes and tracks per timeline. While indexing enabled audio scopes, reject a new distinct referenced asset before it can exceed MaxBindings. Before decode bound binding count, clip scopes, aggregate caller-provided encoded bytes and the accepted strict-WAV retained PCM total; each decoder also enforces its own work budget. Provider sampling allocates only bounded exact/channel response state.
binding_semantics: Require exactly one caller binding for every distinct referenced audio asset and no other binding. Every binding declares the exact frozen document hash. Each Document content_hash must equal SHA-256 of the complete strict WAV bytes; URI values are never opened or fetched.
cancellation_semantics: Check context before and throughout document preflight and scope indexing, before and after document freezing, throughout canonical document hashing, before each binding decode, throughout strict WAV decode, before/after request validation and exact sampling, and before publishing a complete provider or source response. Failure returns no partial provider or SourceSample.
channel_semantics: Strict mono emits one exact channel in [FC] order; strict stereo emits two in [FL,FR] order. No inference, rematrix, reorder, normalization or gain occurs before AudioGraph.
document_semantics: Canonical-validate, deep-freeze and hash one complete Document v2. Every enabled clip on an audio track must reference a content-addressed audio asset whose declared duration exactly equals the decoded WAV frame_count/sample_rate; video assets on audio tracks are outside this profile.
evidence_semantics: The AssetID-sorted manifest binds document hash, encoded/sample hashes and their serialization profiles, decoded and graph sample domains, geometry in sample units, deterministic ProbeManifest identity/fingerprint and every decode/selection/retime/source profile. Provider echoes and descriptor digests are validated semantic claims, not signatures or proof against a malicious runtime; outer evidence must bind trusted runtime/worker identity.
excluded_responsibilities: Filesystem/network resource resolution, video-container audio extraction, alternate WAV chunks or sample formats, sinc/polyphase resampling, pitch-preserving time stretch, channel matrix/mix/gain/pan/buses/limiter, PCM output quantization, container encoding, publication, scheduler-wide concurrency and trusted execution attestation are outside this profile.
probe_semantics: Create one validated ProbeManifest from the strict decoder result: WAVE start zero, stream index zero, pcm_s16le, time base 1/sample_rate, exact frame duration, mono/FC or stereo/FL,FR, and zero encoder delay/padding. Probe BuildFingerprint is the deterministic canonical digest of the source and decoder semantic descriptors, not a binary, toolchain or supply-chain identity; OptionsFingerprint binds the explicit versioned probe options. Neither fingerprint depends on host media-tool defaults.
request_semantics: Accept only the frozen document/scope IDs and indexes, exact independently recomputed timeline/local/source mapping, asset kind/hash/size, manifest fingerprint, stream zero, sample rate/layout/channel order, AudioGraph source/domain profiles and the three binding-frozen decode/selection/retime profiles. The response owns a complete request echo and exact ordered channel samples.
retime_semantics: The evaluator owns timeline-to-source mapping. Sampling that exact SourceTime with this linear kernel implements varispeed: speed and pitch change together. Pitch-preserving time stretch is explicitly outside this profile.
sampling_semantics: Let p=SourceTimeSeconds*sample_rate as an exact non-negative rational. At integer p return frame p. Otherwise linearly interpolate each channel between floor(p) and floor(p)+1 with exact rational weights, divide signed PCM16 words by 32768, and perform no rounding, clipping or float conversion.
terminal_semantics: Valid source time is half-open [0,frame_count/sample_rate). When floor(p) is the final frame and p is fractional, hold the final frame through the remaining terminal sample cell. Source time at or beyond duration, negative time, empty decoded media, loop, zero padding and extrapolation are rejected.
